sourcesPage.title: Methods and sources
sourcesPage.forecastBody: Open-Meteo (combined forecast models, “best match”), CC BY 4.0 licence, non-commercial use. Collected every 3 hours for an interior point of each of the 360 councils; the app only reads this cache.
sourcesPage.boundariesBody: COD-AB Cameroon (OCHA / National Institute of Cartography), version v01 valid on 4 January 2019, CC BY-IGO licence. 10 regions, 58 divisions, 360 councils. Geometries simplified to about 55 m for the app. Accents restored for a few names (Yaoundé, Ngaoundéré, Édéa…).
sourcesPage.limitsBody: Forecasts are for one point per council: in large councils, rainfall can differ between neighbourhoods. Past totals are model estimates and do not replace a rain gauge.
